description: Carried over from iteration-6 FIND-006, still unresolved: no persisted evidence artifact of a green `node --test` run exists anywhere on disk (Glob for `**/evidence/**` under `apps/life-call/` and under the feature directory returns only pre-existing transit fixtures + two unrelated research notes — nothing for this C1 fix). Necessary-but-not-sufficient static checks (all requires resolve, no orphaned references to deleted clip files, nixpacks.toml clean) are in the verdict, but they do not substitute for an actual green test-run transcript.
